summary: User-reported while validating MPI-436: 8K sources lag the Adjust sliders. This is the ceiling MPI-436 shipped with a ponytail: comment naming the fix - 1563ms first move and 64ms per frame at 4096, against 247/7 at 2048. Filed under the MPI-440 umbrella. The trap is written into the card: a fix that only defers the 1563ms leaves the drag at 15fps, so both numbers must fall.

Picked up as the next MPI-440 member. Taking option 1 from the brief FIRST as the card demands: bound the distance field to the painted content bounding box padded by the max slider radius. It is exact - no radius precision spent, so MPI-441's exactness survives - and it cuts the per-frame writeRange by the same factor as the build. The 1536 cap (option 2) stays unspent unless the measurement says the box alone is not enough.

BUILT, awaiting the user's in-app pass. Option 1 taken and the 1536 cap NOT spent, so MPI-441's exactness survives: fieldOverContent() builds the field over the ink's bounding box padded by the max radius, and previewAdjust() clips every op to that box. The clip was the half the card did not predict - once the field shrank the FILLS were the cost, 46ms a frame for a full-canvas fillRect plus drawImage. Measured at a 4096 layer: normal scribble 70ms then 0.4ms (was 1563 then 64), wide scribble 100ms then 2.9ms. Byte-for-byte identical to the old path on grow, shrink and band (diffBytes 0). 423/423 unit tests. Remainder recorded honestly: paint covering the WHOLE 4096 layer is still 1623ms then 65ms, and only the resolution cap moves it - that decision is left unspent and marked ponytail.
User confirmed the Adjust sliders verified in the app; final completion approved 2026-08-05.
